---
title: RefPwa
filters:
  - jimjam-slam/quarto-svelte
quarto-svelte:
  use:
    - ../components/ListRenderer.svelte
execute:
  echo: false
format:
  html:
    title-block-banner: false
    title-block-style: none
    include-in-header: 
      - text: |
          <link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json">
          <meta name="theme-color" content="#0d6efd">
          <script>
            if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
              window.addEventListener('load', () => {
                navigator.serviceWorker.register('posts/sw.js')
                  .then(reg => console.log('Service Worker registered! Scope:', reg.scope))
                  .catch(err => console.log('Service Worker registration failed:', err));
              });
            }
          </script>
---

RefPWA is a fork of Refui as installable Progressive Web Application.

Touch points are:
1. _quarto.yaml resources to be copied into output
2. this refpwa.qmd include-in-header:
3. posts/manifest.json
4. posts/sw.js

1. A sole manifest.json in same folder is sufficient to make this document an installable PWA with keys like "start_url": "/resvlt/posts/refpwa.html", "scope": "/resvlt/posts/",
2. optionally, install sw.js in this document header inline.

::: {#inputDiv}
<!-- inputDiv is considered Void-->
:::

```{ojs}
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// IMPORT #1: bcv_parser
import { bcv_parser } from "./bcv_parser.js"; // this is native bcv_parser

// IMPORT#2: default language tables directly here
import { grammar_options, regexps, translations } from "./lang/en.js"

// bcv_parser INSTANCE to with language to be used as such or passed further 
bcv = new bcv_parser({grammar_options, regexps, translations})

//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// or passed further to SUPER RefEngine2
import { RefEngine, monobloc } from "./refengine.js";

engine = new RefEngine(bcv);

import { bsInput } from "./refui_sole.js";

  viewof ref = new bsInput({
    prefixHTML: "<i class='bi bi-book'></i>",
    placeholder: "Enter reference",
    addLabel: "Add",
    resetLabel: "RAZ",
//    transform: (txt, prev) => txt
    transform: (txt, prev) => engine.transform(txt, prev)
  }).node();

//
//  ref.value.osis           // current OSIS
//  ref.value.previousOsis   // previous OSIS
//  ref.value.url_fetchable  // non-null only when OSIS changed
//  ref.value.data           // fetched JSON (only when OSIS changed)

// works OK at least on first one
restyle = {
  // Wait until OJS inserts it into the DOM
  const container = viewof ref;
  const root = document.documentElement;
//  const group = container.querySelector("div.input-group");

  const titleBlock = root.querySelector(".quarto-title-block");
  
  const allButtons = container.querySelectorAll("button");

  queueMicrotask(() => {
  
    if (titleBlock) {
      titleBlock.style.visibility= "hidden";
      titleBlock.style.height= "0";
      titleBlock.style.margin= "0";
      titleBlock.style.padding= "0";
    };
  
   allButtons.forEach(btn => {
      btn.classList.remove("btn-quarto");
      console.log("Hey")
    });
  });
} // end of restyle  

```

::: {#outputDiv}
<!-- outputDiv is a static anchor -->
:::

```{ojs}
// ELEMENT
myList = html`<my-list></my-list>`

// 2. Define a side-effect to mount it to the existing div
sideffect = {
  const target = document.getElementById("outputDiv");
  target.classList.add("special-text")
  // Clear the placeholder
  target.innerHTML = "";
  // Append the viewof DOM element
  target.appendChild(myList);
  return null
}

```
